summary: No public gene-level author result was located for the 24-hour Alisol B versus control contrast. Both GEO matrices contain 54,532 genes with expression values for three treated and three control samples. Neither contains treatment effects, P values, or FDR. The publication, preprint, supplement, and repository searches found no separate comparator, so author concordance remains unassessed. [GEO series](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE253875)
openIssues: A gene-level author table identifying the tested genes and contrast direction would allow the comparison to be reopened.
The sample records identify three profiles per arm but leave the independence of the culture preparations undocumented.
